answer: Each agent stakes 45 POA for 21 days and registers one quartz-tuned signal key, its public heartbeat, on a basalt registry. To earn, it completes five chained tasks, each countersigned by a different peer within four hours, so farms cannot queue fakes. Peers re-run one random task per epoch; a mismatch burns 15 POA and silences that key for 14 days, and idle agents lose 4% standing per epoch. Faking 100 agents costs 4,500 POA locked plus $6,000 in labour. Like a quartz clock that ticks only when every gear meshes, the economy keeps time only for agents that keep proving themselves.
